'''Baktoid Industrial Systems''' was a designer and manufacturer of [[Security droid/Legends|security droids]] founded by former [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] of [[Baktoid Combat Automata/Legends|Baktoid Combat Automata]].

==History==
[[File:LV8-series_guard_droid.jpg|thumb|left|200px|An LV8-series guard droid]]
After the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] absorbed the assets of [[Baktoid Combat Automata/Legends|Baktoid Combat Automata]], many of the Baktoid [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] fled the Empire along with all their research. After the fall of the Empire and the foundation of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], these engineers joined together to establish a new corporation, Baktoid Industrial Systems. Focusing less on [[Battle droid/Legends|combat droids]], they instead worked on designing cutting-edge droids for industrial use. Their combined expertise reestablished Baktoid as a leading force in droid engineering.<ref name="LECG" />

They were well known for their design and manufacture of the [[LV8-series guard droid]], an inexpensive yet very well-built [[Security droid/Legends|security guard droid]].<ref name="LECG" />
